MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 26

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 12
   C. 14
   D. 10

4. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

5. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

6. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 17
   D. 73

7. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 49

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

10. Solve for x: x + 5 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 5
   C. 5
   D. 4

11. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

12. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 15
   C. 1
   D. 56

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
